initial_prompts.mobile_network:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production arcade game animated customer emote sprite sheet.
Primary request: ONE square 1024 x 1024 pixel sprite sheet, EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, sixteen equal square 256px cells, no visible grid. The SAME SINGLE waist-up human character appears once in every cell, sixteen poses of the same person, fixed character scale, position, bottom baseline and camera across every frame.
Subject: stylish young Black woman network engineer, cobalt hoodie orange headset, handheld phone.
Style/medium: crisp chunky outlined arcade pixel art with a 96px character feel, hard square pixels, vibrant warm accents. Uniform pure BLACK #000000 backdrop. No environmental scenery.
Layout: invisible cell bounds at x=0,256,512,768,1024 and y=0,256,512,768,1024. Character plus every prop and particle fits fully inside each cell with a 12 percent empty margin on every side. Head centered consistently, waist-up torso baseline identical across cells. No character or effect crosses cells.
Reading left to right:
TOP ROW = four sequential WORK/GREETING animation frames: this person taps her phone and signal arc lights; distinct changing arms, hands, expression and prop gesture, then returns toward opening pose.
SECOND ROW = four sequential PATIENT WAITING emote frames: this person phone shows absent signal and eyebrow up; puzzled eyebrow, checks prop or wrist, gentle shrug, returns; patient approachable expressions, no anger or tears.
THIRD ROW = four sequential THANK-YOU CELEBRATION emote frames: this person delighted call gesture and thumbs-up; smile, gesture lifts, peak tiny sparkle, settles. No money icons.
BOTTOM ROW = four sequential RESTING emote frames: eyes comfortably closed already in the FIRST frame, tools lowered, relaxed shoulders, calm exhale and returning calm pose. Remains resting all four cells.
Animation must show actual meaningful changes in arms, face and props; do not just move the entire character up and down. Preserve identity, age, complexion, hair, clothing and props perfectly in all 16 frames. Fixed lighting. All outlines remain visible against black.
Avoid: text, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, frames, panel borders, grid lines, extra people, whole-body bobbing, extreme pose change, cropped limbs or cropped props, perspective shift, smooth vector art, photorealism.

In particular all head/hair/hat pixels must be wholly inside their own cell, none at the top image edge, and every arm and bottom silhouette must fit fully, none at the bottom image edge. Flatten all transparent areas to pure black including between cells; no transparency or colored fringe. Do not add grid lines, text, labels, borders or any new art. Output same square sheet, ideally 1024x1024. The ONLY change is making each sprite smaller within its original cell and blackening blank background.
